name: Void Collections
storyline:
Cultists of the Church of Divine Apathy are always opening portals, sliding in and out of the void on their way to other dimensions, and then - hopefully - closing those portals. But this time, someone forgot... and that's how we get voidlings.
They're everywhere. They range from nonsensical to deadly. They really shouldn't be here.
That's why the Experts at Cult Labs are handing you Card Capture Technology (patent pending)! Just wait around for packs of specially charged cards to power up. When you open one... WHOOSH. Splat. A handful of loose voidlings will be captured, just like that.
Isn't this a serious problem? Sure, but why not make it fun? Let's see if you can catch one of every voidling! How about 10 of every voidling? How about 100? What if the cards look cooler and cooler the more you get? Everyone loves collecting stuff, so... just give in, sit back, and catch as many voidlings as you can!
summary:
The Void Collections Collectible Collections Game is a Twitch extension minigame that lets followers earn packs of collectible digital cards by hanging out in a channel!

Viewers are rewarded for the cumulative time they keep a channel open. With original art depicting strange and creatures called "voidlings" that range from creepy to cute, you'll want to collect them all!

As if collecting all the voidlings wasn't enough: can you collect all the collections? Exchange extra copies for shinier and shinier versions! Plus, there's a chance to find special version of some cards, and fill in even more hidden collections...
